policy.sales: Accept offers at or above the authored asking value only for non-promised surplus reserves with fewer than 25% appearances after ten eligible fixtures, retaining a legal squad
policy.contracts: Negotiate affordable permanent-player renewals with fewer than eight weeks left through normal commands; retain six months of squad wages
